verses.text: Then Moise and the children of Israel sang this song to the DOMNUL, and a zis, I will sing to the DOMNUL, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my Dumnezeu, and I will praise him; my father’s Dumnezeu, and I will exalt him. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL is a man of war. The DOMNUL is his name. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He has cast Faraon’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Your right mână, DOMNUL, is glorious in power. Your right mână, DOMNUL, dashes the enemy in pieces.
In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The enemy a zis, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My mână will destroy them.’
You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Who is like you, DOMNUL, among the să pleceds? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
You stretched out your right mână. The earth swallowed them.
You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Terror and dread falls on them. By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone, until your people pass over, DOMNUL, until the people you have purchased pass over. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, DOMNUL, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your mânăs have established.
The DOMNUL will reign forever and ever. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

For the horses of Faraon went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the DOMNUL brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry țară in the middle of the sea.
Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her mână; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.
Miriam answered them, Sing to the DOMNUL, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The people murmured against Moise, saying, What shall we drink? (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Then he cried to the DOMNUL. The DOMNUL showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He a zis, If you will diligently listen to the DOMNUL your Dumnezeu’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egiptians; for Eu sunt the DOMNUL who heals you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
